samoa.title: Flag of the Independent State of Samoa

colors.note: The five stars of the Southern Cross representing purity

desc:
- Red field with a blue rectangle in the upper hoist quadrant containing five white five-pointed stars in the configuration of the Southern Cross
- Adopted on 24 February 1949, with a fifth small star added to the four-star 1948 version
trivia:
- Samoa was the first small Pacific nation to gain independence in the postwar era, on 1 January 1962
- The original 1948 flag had only four stars; the smaller Epsilon Crucis star was added in 1949
- The country was known as Western Samoa until 1997, when it officially shortened its name to simply Samoa
